items.prompt:
Summarize the text below in a single paragraph.

The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late eighteenth century and spread across Europe and North America over the following hundred years. It replaced hand production with machines, introduced new chemical and iron production processes, and made steam power central to manufacturing. Cities grew rapidly as workers left the countryside for factory jobs, which changed family structures and created entirely new social classes. Living conditions in the early industrial cities were often severe: housing was crowded, air and water were polluted, and working hours were long, including for children. Over time, labour movements and legislation improved conditions, while continued mechanisation raised average incomes and life expectancy across industrialised nations.

Summarize the text below in exactly 4 bullet points.

Renewable energy sources now supply a growing share of global electricity. Solar photovoltaic costs have fallen by roughly ninety percent since 2010, making solar the cheapest source of new generation in many markets. Wind power, both onshore and offshore, has followed a similar trajectory, with turbines growing steadily larger and more efficient. The main remaining obstacle is intermittency: solar and wind generate power only when the sun shines or the wind blows, which forces grid operators to balance supply and demand across the day. Battery storage, long-distance transmission and demand-response programmes are the three approaches most often used to address this, and all three are expanding quickly.

Read the text and list the three key takeaways.

Remote work moved from a niche arrangement to a mainstream practice during the early 2020s. Companies that adopted it reported lower office costs and access to a wider hiring pool, while employees reported saving commuting time and gaining flexibility. The drawbacks appeared more slowly: onboarding new staff proved harder without informal contact, junior employees received less incidental mentoring, and the boundary between work and personal time blurred for many. Most large organisations eventually settled on hybrid schedules, typically two or three days in the office, as a compromise that preserved some flexibility while restoring face-to-face collaboration.

Summarize the text below in exactly one sentence.

The Amazon rainforest covers about 5.5 million square kilometres across nine countries and holds roughly ten percent of all known species on Earth. It plays a major role in regulating regional rainfall and in storing carbon. Deforestation, driven mainly by cattle ranching, soy cultivation and logging, has removed close to a fifth of the original forest cover. Scientists warn that continued clearing could push parts of the ecosystem past a tipping point, after which the forest would gradually transition into drier savannah, releasing large quantities of stored carbon.

Summarize the technical text below for a non-technical reader, in under 60 words.

A transformer processes a sequence by mapping each token to a vector and repeatedly refining those vectors through self-attention and feed-forward sublayers. Self-attention computes, for every position, a weighted average over all other positions, where the weights come from the similarity between learned query and key projections. Because these weights are computed for all pairs simultaneously, the operation parallelises well on modern accelerators but scales quadratically with sequence length.

O Pantanal é a maior planície alagável do planeta e se estende pelo Brasil, pela Bolívia e pelo Paraguai. Durante a estação chuvosa, os rios transbordam e cobrem grande parte da região, criando um ciclo anual de cheia e seca que sustenta uma fauna extremamente rica, incluindo onças-pintadas, ariranhas e centenas de espécies de aves.
